author: Duds
text:
Posting up some homework

i enjoyed this one.. One question I have if someone

knows the answer! Sometimes when compression ends it takes off in the same direction that the compression was moving vs coming back through it. Is there a way to see this coming??

author: greywind5
text:
Hey friend I'm glad to see you post your homework, it seems you're even going faster than me, and you're doing a great job

To answer your question, I think Compression doesn't tell us the way market is going to go once it touches the next FTR, It can simply ignore that FTR and go to the next. What we know for sure, is that all buy orders (in bull CP example) have been cleared so when price breaks back into that compression, it will be very likely to see price going through in short amount of time.

Alert: newbie answer.

Afternoon all,

I've not had much time to post since my last visit but I have been doing homework when I can.

I've been taking it slow initially, knowing myself, I have a tendancy to jump straight in with a little knowledge. I'm trying to make sure I understand the concept and the reasoning behind it rather than 'that's what happens when the price reaches there'.

What I have found so far is that courage in your conviction is essential.

I will hopefully be able to post more of my homework from this week forwards, as well as live trades (small amounts) to help me learn not only the markets but myself and how I react.
